title: Improving Geo-diversity of Generated Images with Contextualized Vendi Score Guidance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the representation and diversity of everyday objects generated by text-to-image models across different worldwide regions. The evaluation uses geographically representative datasets (GeoDE and DollarStreet) and measures disparities using metrics like worst-region and average F1, precision, recall, and CLIPScore.

Measuring the performance (F1 score) of generated images across different income buckets (e.g., low income vs. high income) using the DollarStreet dataset to assess how socioeconomic contexts influence object representation.
